name: gity
$comment: ADR-006 — vcpkg carries the small C libraries on Windows and macOS. Qt is NOT here: building it from source costs hours per cold CI run and diverges from the binaries Qt supports. Linux uses system packages. The ports are pinned by the vcpkg release CI checks out (VCPKG_TAG in .github/workflows/ci.yml).

dependencies.name: libgit2
dependencies.$comment: pcre2 is not optional: with default-features off, libgit2's port fails outright with 'Must choose pcre or pcre2 regex backend'. No ssh: every network operation goes through the git binary (ADR-003), so libgit2 never needs libssh2.
